info.name: 05 JWT Authentication
info.description: Login -> token -> protected endpoints, every kind of rejected token, refresh rotation with reuse detection, logout, and disabling a user. Run in order; re-runnable. The hand-made tokens in folder 3 are all unusable on purpose.

exec: pm.test('message: Authentication is required to access this resource', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Authentication is required to access this resource"));
pm.test('header: HS256 + kid of the active key', () => pm.expect(header).to.eql({kid: 'k2026-10', alg: 'HS256'}));

pm.test('payload: sub, iss, jti, iat, exp, authorities', () => { pm.expect(payload.sub).to.eql('hana'); pm.expect(payload.iss).to.eql('hr-portal'); pm.expect(payload.jti).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(payload.exp - payload.iat).to.eql(900); pm.expect(payload.authorities).to.eql(['EMPLOYEE_READ', 'EMPLOYEE_WRITE', 'ROLE_HR']); });
pm.test('message: Invalid username or password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid username or password"));
pm.test('message: Invalid username or password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid username or password"));
pm.test('message: Account is disabled', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Account is disabled"));
pm.test('message: password must not be blank', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("password must not be blank"));

item.name: 2. Token -> protected endpoints (authorities from the token)

exec: pm.test('hana, HR authorities', () => { const me = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(me.username).to.eql('hana'); pm.expect(me.authorities).to.eql(['EMPLOYEE_READ', 'EMPLOYEE_WRITE', 'ROLE_HR']); });
pm.test('message: You do not have permission to access this resource', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("You do not have permission to access this resource"));
pm.test('message: Authorization header must be: Bearer <token>', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Authorization header must be: Bearer <token>"));

pm.test('WWW-Authenticate invalid_token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Authorization header must be: Bearer <token>"'));
pm.test('message: Token is malformed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Token is malformed"));
pm.test('WWW-Authenticate invalid_token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Token is malformed"'));
pm.test('message: Token has expired', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Token has expired"));
pm.test('WWW-Authenticate invalid_token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Token has expired"'));
pm.test('message: Token signature is invalid', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Token signature is invalid"));
pm.test('WWW-Authenticate invalid_token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Token signature is invalid"'));

item.name: TAMPERED: hana's real token with USER_MANAGE added to the payload

exec: // decode the payload, add USER_MANAGE, encode it again, keep the ORIGINAL signature
pm.test('message: Token signature is invalid', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Token signature is invalid"));
pm.test('WWW-Authenticate invalid_token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Token signature is invalid"'));
pm.test('message: Token must be signed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Token must be signed"));
pm.test('WWW-Authenticate invalid_token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Token must be signed"'));
pm.test('message: Token was signed with an unknown key', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Token was signed with an unknown key"));

pm.test('WWW-Authenticate invalid_token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Token was signed with an unknown key"'));
pm.test('message: Token was not issued by this server', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Token was not issued by this server"));

pm.test('WWW-Authenticate invalid_token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Token was not issued by this server"'));

item.name: OLD refresh token again -> 401 reuse detected

exec: pm.test('message: Refresh token reuse detected; please log in again', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Refresh token reuse detected; please log in again"));

item.name: ... and the newest one is revoked with it

exec: pm.test('message: Refresh token has been revoked', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Refresh token has been revoked"));
pm.test('message: Refresh token is invalid', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Refresh token is invalid"));
pm.test('message: Token has been revoked', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Token has been revoked"));
pm.test('WWW-Authenticate invalid_token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Token has been revoked"'));

item.name: 6. Disable a user: the limit of stateless tokens
asha's EXISTING access token still works (until it expires)

exec: pm.test('message: Refresh token has been revoked', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Refresh token has been revoked"));
pm.test('message: Account is disabled', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Account is disabled"));

item.name: admin revokes all of asha's sessions

exec: pm.test('message: You cannot disable your own account', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("You cannot disable your own account"));
